<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Rebbe Rayatz requests that the hides for the Torah scroll be from slaughtered and kosher animals, with careful supervision, for the sake of greeting Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"With this I am coming to fill his hand to deal with the matter of the hides needed for processing the parchment for the Torah scroll that is being written, with G-d's help, specifically for the reception of our righteous Moshiach, speedily and in our days,</t>
    <t s="1">that they should be from slaughtered and kosher [animals], and they should please supervise this precisely,</t>
    <t s="2">and the Almighty will grant us the merit to receive our righteous Moshiach, speedily and in our days, with kindness and mercy."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>All expenses for the parchment and scribe were paid personally by the Rebbe Rayatz, and donations were given to educational and camp funds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">All the expenses for the acquisition of the parchment and the scribe's wages</t>
    <t s="1">(the chassid Shmaryahu Factor, of blessed memory),</t>
    <t s="2">everything was on the personal account of the Rebbe, the Admore"r HaRayatz,</t>
    <t s="3">and the donations that were donated for this he gave to the fund of the "Merkaz L'Inyanei Chinuch" and the fund of "Machaneh Yisrael"13.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Torah scroll was begun at that time, but its completion was delayed for many years.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The Torah scroll was begun and written then,</t>
    <t s="1">but its completion was delayed for many years.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
